top_signals.title: Iran Refuses to Soften Demands as Trump Rejects Hormuz Offer
top_signals.summary:
Mike McGlone, Senior Commodity Strategist for Bloomberg Intelligence, joined Bloomberg's Paul Sweeney and Scarlet Fu to talk about the state of the oil and trade market as the US and Iran continue talks.
Iran and the US appeared far apart on a new ceasefire deal or the reopening of the Strait of Hormuz, with Tehran saying it’s sticking to a proposal US President Donald Trump has rejected.
Tehran made an offer to reopen the strait within seven days if Washington makes some concessions, which it hasn’t specified. Its leaders have previously said the US must lift a naval blockade and oil sanctions for there to be any progress on allowing more ships through the vital waterway. (Source: Bloomberg)
top_signals.why_it_matters: Geopolitical escalation affecting commodities, shipping and cross-asset volatility.

top_signals.title: Zambia Firm Accuses Abu Dhabi’s IRH of Copper Mine Deal Breaches
top_signals.summary: A Zambian state firm has accused Abu Dhabi’s International Resources Holding of breaching agreements under which the Emirati company acquired control of the Mopani copper mining complex in early 2024.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Commodity repricing impacting inflation expectations and industrial supply chains.

top_signals.title: Crypto PAC spends $11M to oppose Sherrod Brown in Ohio
top_signals.summary: Fairshake pledged an initial $30 million on media opposing the Democratic candidate in Ohio’s Senate race in what some see as a repeat of spending by the crypto industry in 2024.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Digital asset volatility and institutional crypto positioning changes.

top_signals.title: "Made in Restaurants" Initiative Helps Shape People, Careers and Communities, says Korsmo
top_signals.summary:
Michelle Korsmo, CEO of National Restaurant Association, joined Bloomberg's Paul Sweeney and Scarlet Fu  to discuss the state of the restaurant industry and the National Restaurant Association launching the "Made in Restaurants" initiative.. 
CNH's contracting top line is likely to reach a trough this year, yet industrial leverage will remain elevated, limiting flexibility within its BBB-tier ratings and necessitating more patience before a more meaningful improvement in financial risk takes hold. the company's policy of prioritizing investment-grade standing as a foundational commitment is a linchpin for credit quality as more tangible proof of stronger farmer fundamentals is sought. (Source: Bloomberg)

top_signals.title: Getty Images in Talks With Lenders for Potential Bankruptcy Loan
top_signals.summary: Getty Images Holdings Inc. is holding confidential talks with lenders about injecting new money into the cash-strapped company, potentially through a debtor-in-possession loan, according to people familiar with the situation.
